name: Rob Jetten
role: Prime Minister of the Netherlands (since 2026); D66 leader; Minister for Climate and Energy (2022-2024)
summary: A social-liberal who leads D66, he combines climate and energy transition policy with openness to nuclear power, deep European integration, higher defence spending and personal-liberty positions such as euthanasia and drug regulation. Since 2025 he has also argued for a stricter, more controlled asylum policy, including processing claims outside the EU.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 2.3 and 8.3: raises the minimum wage and the youth minimum wage, with welfare benefits rising in step.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 8.3: taxes large fortunes more, including a millionaires' tax, and shifts the burden from work to wealth; the December 2025 D66-CDA agenda also puts more of the burden on wealth.

regulate-corporations.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 5.3 and 7.1: a statutory social duty of care for directors of large companies, firm action against market power, fines for greenwashing and tougher EU action on big tech.

cut-welfare.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 2.3 and 5.4: raises the minimum benefit level and says assistance must be enough to live on, but shortens the duration of unemployment benefit and calls for activation. Evidence points both ways.

legalize-drugs.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 3.1: legalise and tax soft drugs, ecstasy and psilocybin mushrooms and do not criminalise users; hard drugs are handled case by case, so not all recreational drugs.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.2-1.3: platforms must remove online hate messages and are liable if they fail, and a broad anti-discrimination law is planned; D66 also defends the right to speak even when it chafes.

empower-police-military.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.3 and 7.2, and the coalition agreement he leads: more local police and investigative capacity, and defence spending of at least 3.5% of GDP, though with less police effort on minor offences.

rehabilitation.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.3: replaces very short prison terms with longer community service or electronic detention for better return to society, while serious criminals serve full sentences.

abortion-legal.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 3.5: abortion fully out of criminal law and access to abortion written into the constitution.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.4-1.6: Keti Koti becomes a national holiday, continued work on the slavery past and its legacy, a slavery museum, and a broad anti-discrimination law.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.5: wants heritage, including monuments, regional languages and traditions, made resilient and accessible.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.3: wants the UN Security Council veto abolished, an international force mandated by the UN for Gaza, and respect for the ICC and ICJ.

free-trade.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.3: says international trade drives the world and Dutch economy, wants Europe to be 'champion of free trade' and to approve EU-Mercosur quickly, while tying agreements to standards.

nation-first.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 7.1 and 7.3: foreign policy is European, international law is 'not a menu', and the Netherlands should take responsibility with partners rather than act on its own interests alone.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.3: calls for a UN-mandated intervention force in Gaza under Responsibility to Protect and continued military support to Ukraine.

open-borders.rationale: In a June 2025 interview he called the migration system broken and wanted asylum requests handled outside the EU under a 'Canadian model'; the coalition he leads aims for closed but humane reception at the external border.

limit-growth.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections intro to ch. 5: wants an economy that flourishes 'within planetary limits' and a smaller livestock herd but rests on green growth and innovation.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: As Minister for Climate and Energy (2022-2024) he drove climate policy, and the programme he led sets a 90% emissions cut by 2040 and net zero by 2050 in law, calling climate his party's top priority in 2023.

expand-nuclear.rationale: As minister he took steps toward two new plants at Borssele, announced in Zwolle in 2023 that D66 changed position, and as leader of the cabinet his coalition agreement commits to building new nuclear plants and speeding up small reactors.

tax-inheritance.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 8.3: makes inheritance and gift tax 'more modern and more progressive' because financial security should not be an inherited luxury.

state-directs-investment.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 5.1-5.2: a National Investment Bank for large transitions, mission-driven innovation policy with subsidies and government procurement in key technologies, and a minister for technology.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: keeps the monarchy but abolishes the king's political roles; mixed rather than clear support for or opposition to a hereditary head of state.

direct-votes.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: makes referendums possible to stop legislation (a corrective, not citizens deciding laws directly) and holds more citizens' forums.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 6.2: explores legal rights for natural areas and says nature counts in every spatial decision.

positive-liberty.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), introduction: defines social liberalism as freedom that only truly exists when everyone has the opportunities and means to be free.

territorial-expansion.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 7.2-7.3: defends the international legal order against power politics and supports Ukraine against Russian aggression.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.5: a library in every neighbourhood, structural support for museums and a heritage policy that keeps history alive.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 5.1 and the coalition agreement: end gas imports from authoritarian states, phase out fossil subsidies and remaining small-field gas, keep Groningen closed and allow no new Wadden gas permits.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.1 and 1.6: equal treatment for everyone as a fundamental right, a broad anti-discrimination law and the stated aim that everyone counts 'without exception'.

separated-powers.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: wants a stricter separation of powers, stronger independent watchdogs, inspectorates and judges, and limits on political influence on the judiciary and prosecution service.

party-controls-media.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: protect journalists, strengthen independent investigative and local media and public broadcasting, and put the journalistic code in law.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.1: favours deep European integration and further federalisation, direct election of the Commission president, a doubled EU budget with own revenue and no vetoes on sanctions.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.2: wants a strong position inside NATO and wider defence cooperation with the UK, Canada, Japan and Australia.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.3: restores development cooperation toward 0.7% of GDP after previous cuts.

collective-defense.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.2 and the coalition agreement: commits to NATO's 3.5% spending pledge and a strong European pillar inside NATO; Jetten has said Ukraine support continues while aggression continues.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: removes the king's political functions as incompatible with a modern state, which leaves a ceremonial role.

ban-cartels.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 5.3: wants fair competition and to intervene firmly when a company holds too much market power.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: gives courts the power to test laws against the constitution and strengthens judicial independence.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.3: states D66 stands firm for equal representation in politics, without specifying a legal quota for public bodies.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.3 and 5.1: human rights, labour conditions, women's position and the environment are to guide trade deals, and trade and cooperation agreements are tied to CO2 reduction.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.6: a new anti-discrimination law with active duties for private organisations such as employers and landlords, and penalties for discriminating employers.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.1 and 3.5: lets judges review laws against the constitution, and writes abortion and euthanasia access into the constitution.

parliament-supreme.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: abolishes the political functions of the king and the Senate and expands parliament and its staff.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 6.3: treats animals as sentient beings, calls animal welfare a moral compass and wants animals' legal position in the constitution.

non-intervention.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.3: supports sanctions, a UN-mandated force under Responsibility to Protect and support for democratisation abroad.

public-access-to-information.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: openness should be the norm in government, with more insight into lobbying of decisions and open source in public IT.

national-law-over-international.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.1 and 7.3: international law is 'not a menu' and is to be defended in word and deed; criticises selective compliance by the previous cabinet.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.3, 1.6 and 7.3: defends the freedom to love whom one wants, fights hatred against LGBT people and supports LGBT rights abroad.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.6: pays special attention to people excluded on several grounds at once and uses the term intersectionality.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.3, 3.2 and 8.1: faster transgender care, recognition and protection of non-binary and intersex people, easier sex registration and a ban on conversion practices.

assisted-dying.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 3.5: wants a wider euthanasia law including psychiatric suffering and dementia, a legal route for completed life, and euthanasia out of criminal law.

social-market-economy.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), introduction: calls D66 social-liberal and combines entrepreneurship and competition rules with social security, a minimum income floor and public intervention against market power.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.2 and the coalition agreement: builds up the armed forces to at least 3.5% of GDP.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.2: puts the Netherlands firmly in NATO and in European defence, with wider cooperation with allied democracies.

citizens-assembly.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: more often organises citizens' forums so people can speak on major national themes.

second-chamber.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: abolishes the Eerste Kamer (Senate).

pollution-taxes.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 5.1 and 2.2: pollution gets a predictable 'real price', fossil subsidies are phased out and road-pricing and a flight tax replace vehicle ownership taxes; limits and subsidies remain part of the mix.

future-generations.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.1 and 6.1: an ombudsman for future generations and spatial choices based on what is good for later generations.

public-service-media.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 1.1: invest in a strong public broadcaster with trustworthy information, kept free of improper influence, with public money watched.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), section 7.4: asylum seekers with good prospects must learn Dutch; labour migrants are introduced to the language. This covers some immigrants only.

women-suffrage.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.3 and 7.1: equal representation of women in politics and defence of equal rights for women and men.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 1.1 and 7.3: documenting violations for follow-up prosecution of individuals at the ICC and states at the ICJ, in Gaza and Ukraine.

close-ties-china.rationale: D66 programme 'Het kan wél' 2025-2030 (Jetten as lijsttrekker, foreword signed by him), sections 7.1 and 7.3: wants to cut dependence on China and see European economic security less exposed to Chinese state aid.

notes: Most answers rest on the D66 programme he led, so they are medium confidence unless backed by his own statements or ministerial record. Where the programme and coalition deal differ, the more recent coalition deal wins (e.g. nuclear). The programme's Gaza section is party text; it was not used as a separate personal position beyond international-law answers. Born 1987.
